definition: to put things back where they belong
exampleSentence: Put things away when you finish.
exampleTranslation: Dùng xong thì cất đồ đạc đi nhé.

definition: to return something to its place
exampleSentence: Please put it back after you use it.
exampleTranslation: Dùng xong hãy để lại chỗ cũ nhé.

definition: to empty a place and get rid of things you do not need
exampleSentence: I want to clear out the garage.
exampleTranslation: Tôi muốn dọn bớt đồ trong nhà để xe.

definition: to remove things you do not need from a place
translation: dọn bớt đồ, loại bỏ đồ thừa
exampleSentence: We decluttered the living room.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi dọn bớt đồ trong phòng khách.

definition: to put things you do not need in the rubbish
exampleSentence: I throw out old things every spring.
exampleTranslation: Mỗi mùa xuân tôi vứt bớt đồ cũ.

definition: to give clothes you do not want to other people
exampleSentence: I give away clothes that are too small.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cho đi những bộ quần áo đã quá chật.

definition: to give clothes to a charity
exampleSentence: We donate clothes to a local charity.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi quyên góp quần áo cho một tổ chức từ thiện địa phương.

definition: to tidy a cupboard and decide what to keep
exampleSentence: I will sort out the cupboard this weekend.
exampleTranslation: Cuối tuần này tôi sẽ sắp xếp lại tủ.

definition: to put the things on a shelf in a clear order
exampleSentence: She organised the shelf by colour.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy sắp xếp kệ theo màu sắc.

definition: to put the furniture in a different order or place
exampleSentence: We rearranged the furniture in the living room.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi sắp xếp lại đồ đạc trong phòng khách.

definition: to carry furniture to another place
exampleSentence: Can you help me move the furniture?
exampleTranslation: Bạn giúp tôi dời đồ đạc được không?

definition: to create empty space for something
exampleSentence: We need to make room for the new sofa.
exampleTranslation: Chúng ta cần dành chỗ cho chiếc ghế sofa mới.

definition: to put books in a pile
exampleSentence: He stacked the books on the desk.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy xếp chồng sách lên bàn.

definition: to put a picture on the wall
exampleSentence: We hung a picture above the sofa.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi treo một bức tranh phía trên ghế sofa.

definition: to fix a shelf to the wall
exampleSentence: My dad put up a shelf in my room.
exampleTranslation: Bố tôi gắn một cái kệ lên tường trong phòng tôi.

definition: to write on boxes what is inside
exampleSentence: Label the boxes before we move.
exampleTranslation: Ghi nhãn các thùng trước khi chúng ta chuyển nhà.

definition: to bend blankets into neat flat shapes
exampleSentence: Fold the blankets and put them on the bed.
exampleTranslation: Gấp chăn rồi để lên giường.

definition: to put clean sheets on the bed
exampleSentence: I change the sheets every Sunday.
exampleTranslation: Chủ nhật nào tôi cũng thay ga giường.

definition: to shake pillows so they look soft and full
exampleSentence: She plumped the pillows and made the bed.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy vỗ cho gối phồng lên rồi trải giường.

definition: to put toys back in their box or place
exampleSentence: Children, put away the toys now.
exampleTranslation: Các con, cất đồ chơi đi nào.

definition: to collect toys from the floor
exampleSentence: I pick up toys from the floor every evening.
exampleTranslation: Mỗi tối tôi nhặt đồ chơi từ sàn nhà lên.

definition: to not know where your keys are
exampleSentence: I lost my keys again.
exampleTranslation: Tôi lại làm mất chìa khóa rồi.

definition: to discover where your keys are
exampleSentence: I can't find my keys anywhere.
exampleTranslation: Tôi tìm chìa khóa mãi mà không thấy.

definition: to try to find your keys
exampleSentence: I am looking for my keys.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đang tìm chìa khóa.

definition: to keep things neat and in order
exampleSentence: It is easier to keep things tidy every day.
exampleTranslation: Giữ mọi thứ gọn gàng mỗi ngày thì dễ hơn.
